title: Hussain Aaya Sirhaane utho Ali Akbar
body:
HUSSAIN ASWS. AAYA SIRHANE UTHO ALI AKBAR ASWS.
HILAKE SHAANA KAHA KUCH KAHO ALI AKBAR ASWS.
1. KYUN PAOU'N AISE RAGADTE HO QAAK PAR BETA.
HAI DIL PE CHAL RAHA QANJAR KAHO ALI AKBAR ASWS.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. DARE QAYAAM SE RO RO KE DEKHO AY JAANI.
SADAAYE DETI HAIN MAADAR SUNO ALI AKBAR ASWS.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. KOI BATATA NAHI TERI LAASH MAQTAL MEIN.
PIDAR NISAAR SADA PHIR SE DO ALI AKBAR ASWS.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. YEH HAATH SEENE PE KYUN BAAR BAAR RAKHTE HO.
KAHAN PE ZAQM LAGAA HAI KAHO ALI AKBAR ASWS.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. SINA KA PHAL MAIN NIKAALUN TUMHARE SEENE SE.
YEH HAATH ZAQME JIGAR PAR RAKHO ALI AKBAR ASWS.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. PIDAR KE HAATHON PE AKBAR ASWS. KA TOOTA DUM MOMIN.
HUSSAIN ASWS. REH GAYE KEHTE UTHO ALI AKBAR ASWS.
Kalaam: JANAB AKBAR ALI MOMIN SAHAB.
